firstPartyEvidence.finding: ProperPhi CGU states recharge tariffs are decided by the user/client; ProperPhi validates and applies requested tariff changes, confirming site/customer tariff authority.
ProperPhi supervision supports five billing modes including QR/app registration, mobility-operator roaming and direct bank-card payment, with billing/revenue handling.
ProperPhi is an IRVE integrator/operator/supervision provider across enterprise/customer sites, not a single fixed retail tariff network.

corroboratingObservation: Current public site observations show different site prices (e.g. 0.22 EUR/kWh at one 2026 site and 0.35 EUR/kWh at another); treated only as heterogeneity corroboration, not authority.
conclusion: No national ProperPhi direct tariff exists. Exact direct pricing is customer/site-configured; no anonymous deterministic exact station/EVSE -> configured tariff resolver recovered.
reopenCondition: Public/guest ProperPhi supervision tariff endpoint, exact QR/TPE/app tariff payload, or first-party/AFIR/QualiCharge numeric tariff tied to exact EVSE.
